pre_freeze_allowed_operations: automated source copy into a new immutable snapshot directory
pre_freeze_forbidden_operations: display or export final-OOS price or label values to an analyst
compute returns, labels, features, predictions, metrics or slices on final OOS
choose a source, model, parameter, threshold or rule from final-OOS outcomes
modify or replace an existing snapshot in place

access_accounting.automated_sealed_ingestion: does not increment analytical access_count because no outcome-bearing values or statistics are exposed
access_accounting.metric_or_slice_computation: increments access_count and selection_uses and requires replacement OOS

storage_rule: raw snapshot files are read-only; development products must be generated from pre-2025 rows only until the final-OOS opening ceremony
opening_gate: append-only OOS access receipt written before evaluation
limitations: POSIX read-only permissions provide integrity friction, not independent access control
local logs cannot prove that no off-system access occurred
hashes prove content identity, not that vendor history is complete or revision-safe
